title: crowded-folders JSON report
description: What `crowded-folders --format json` prints. A field is only ever added in a minor version; renaming or removing one is a major version and raises `formatVersion`.

formatVersion.description: The version of this shape. It changes only when a field is renamed or removed.

run.description: How the run read its input: what changes the result without changing the code.

presets.description: The presets in effect, in order.

presetsDetected.description: True when there was no configuration file and the presets were detected from the repository.

configFile.description: The configuration file, relative to the root; null when there is none.

fileSource.description: Where the list of files came from.

root.description: The checked root, relative to where the command ran. Never an absolute path.

rule.description: `max-files`; `namespace/rule` for a plugin rule; `config/unused-override` for an override that matches no folder.

folder.description: The folder, relative to the root, with `/`; the root is `.`. Raw, as in the repository: a name may hold control characters, which JSON escapes.

key.description: Tells apart two problems of one rule in one folder (the prefix, for `prefix-groups`); null when the rule has one.

measured.description: The number that broke the limit. For `config/unused-override` it is 1: one override, not a count of anything.

limit.description: The limit as the configuration writes it: `max` for `max-files` and `max-folders`, `min` for `prefix-groups`. For `config/unused-override` it is 0 (there is no limit); null when the rule has none.

comparison.description: How `measured` is compared with `limit`: `>` fails when measured is over the limit (`max` options), `>=` when it reaches it (`min` of `prefix-groups`); null with no limit.

fileCount.description: How many files the finding names, present even with --no-files.

files.description: The files in the folder the finding is about, relative to the root. Left out by --no-files.

moves.description: Where files could go instead; never applied. Left out by --no-files.

project.description: The nearest folder, from the finding's folder upwards, with a package.json, project.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pom.xml or BUILD.bazel; null when none has one. The root is `.`.

owners.description: The CODEOWNERS owners of the folder; empty when none matches or there is no CODEOWNERS.

measured.description: What is measured today; null when the problem is gone.

status.description: Why it is to be pruned: `lowered` is progress, to be saved with --prune-suppressions; `moved` names `movedTo`.

movedTo.description: For `moved`: the folder where the problem looks to be now.

didYouMean.description: For `missing-folder`: a folder that differs only in case.

file.description: The suppressions file that holds it, relative to the root.

knownOnBase.description: With --new-since: the base, and how many problems it already had (they do not fail).

folders.description: Every folder with its numbers. Only with --stats.

limit.description: The `max-files` limit in effect for the folder; null when that rule is off there.
